create_fbgemm_fp8_config: create an FBGEMM FP8 quantization config with ignore list and input scale upper bound
build_fbgemm_fp8_linear_method: build an FBGEMM FP8 linear method to quantize linear layer weights for FP8 inference
test_fbgemm_fp8_config_from_config: test parsing an FBGEMM FP8 config from a dictionary with modules_to_not_convert and activation_scale_ub keys
get_quant_method_linear: get the quantization method for a linear layer using FBGEMM FP8 config and layer prefix
apply_fbgemm_fp8_weights: apply FP8 quantized weights to a linear layer with input tensor and optional bias
